name: Iridic-Veil

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a nearby asteroid belt, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in titanium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
